title: ResourcesResponse
description: JSON-RPC response for the resources discovery method. Returns every registered service and its resource manifest.

errors.description: Services whose manifest could not be fetched. The rest of the response is still usable.

id.description: The reference key, verbatim: `<service>.<resource>`. Usable directly in RPC params and expressions.

name.description: Human-friendly base label for builder display.

attributes.description: Bindable attribute names as dotted paths, declared by the service that owns the resource. The builder uses these for id interpolation instead of guessing from whatever rows happen to have synced, so a resource with no rows yet still offers its attributes. Omitted when the owning service does not declare them.
